newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, hardly talked, NYMEX up.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, hardly talked, NYMEX up.

text.p: August Brent futures were untraded at midday on Tuesday in Asia and hardly talked, while NYMEX futures on the after-hours ACCESS system set a modestly bullish tone.
August Brent on SIMEX was offered at $18.30 per barrel after London rose 13 cents to settle at $18.19.
NYMEX August crude fell four cents in New York to $19.52, but edged five cents higher on ACCESS to last trade at $19.57.
Upward potential is limited amid expectations that Iraq will soon resumes its crude exports, brokers said.
